'''Katsumi Toriumi''' (Japanese: '''鳥海勝美''' ''Toriumi Katsumi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Toriumi was born on November 16, 1963, in {{wp|Chiba, Chiba}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. He provided the voice of {{jo|Harrison}}, {{Ash}}'s [[rival]] in the [[Silver Conference]], during {{aniseries|GS}}. Toriumi is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Production Baobab}}.
